input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: overnight summer camp 2026 Waynesville Canton Old Fort
2026 summer camp residential Brevard Music Center
2026 summer camp Camp Lakey Gap Black Mountain
2026 Camp Hope East Tennessee overnight official

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: Christian day and overnight camps in East Asheville; overnight programs for rising grades 2–10.

candidates.name: UNC Asheville
candidates.note: Weeklong residential pre-college programs for high school students, plus youth summer camps.

candidates.name: Camp Hollymont
candidates.note: Christian residential girls’ camp at Asheville School in West Asheville.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers day camps and residential elementary, middle-school and high-school programs.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Christian residential summer camp for boys ages 7–17; 2027 enrollment announced.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight summer camp with multiple session lengths.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Christian boys’ sleepaway camp; 2027 sessions serve grades 1–11.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls, with two-week residential sessions.

candidates.name: Christmount
candidates.note: Runs Camp Lakey Gap, a weeklong residential camp for autistic campers grouped by age.

candidates.name: Higher Ground Adventures
candidates.note: Weeklong overnight Christian adventure camp near Asheville.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Residential adventure, specialty and leadership camps, plus day camps.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: United Methodist camp offering summer resident and day programs for boys and girls.

candidates.name: Camp Kanuga
candidates.note: Episcopal-affiliated co-ed residential camp for ages 7–15, with short and longer sessions.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish residential camp with traditional activities and shorter rookie sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Judaea
candidates.note: Jewish residential summer programs for rising grades 2–11; 2027 dates posted.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Two-week overnight sessions combining camp activities and off-campus outdoor adventures.

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer
candidates.note: Co-ed residential camp with short introductory sessions, longer stays and teen expeditions.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
candidates.note: Girls’ residential summer camp with horseback riding, water activities and arts.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Christian girls’ residential camp serving grades 1–11 across several session lengths.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ residential camp for grades 1–11, with one- to four-week sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Glen Arden
candidates.note: Girls’ summer camp offering two-, three- and four-week residential sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Residential boys’ camp for ages 6–17 emphasizing outdoor skills and wilderness trips.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls’ residential summer camp with horseback riding and outdoor trips.

candidates.name: Camp Carolina
candidates.note: Boys’ residential adventure camp with introductory and longer summer sessions.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ sleepaway camp for ages 6–16; 2027 residential sessions posted.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Girls’ residential camp with sessions ranging from five days to four weeks.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Co-ed residential camp combining farm, wilderness and traditional camp programs.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ residential camp with riding, sports, arts and climbing; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camps Kahdalea and Chosatonga
candidates.note: Runs Kahdalea for girls and Chosatonga for boys, with residential mountain-adventure programs.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys’ residential outdoor-adventure camp with one- to four-week sessions.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Co-ed overnight nature camp and teen expedition programs on a private wildlife preserve.

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute
candidates.note: Residential middle- and high-school camps in astronomy, space science and research.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Audition-based residential summer music institute includes high-school musicians ages 14–18.

candidates.name: Camp Merrie-Woode
candidates.note: Girls’ residential camp with outdoor adventure, riding, boating and arts.

candidates.name: Girl Scouts Carolinas Peaks to Piedmont
candidates.note: Camp Pisgah summer programs for girls; council summer camps serve rising grades 2–12.

candidates.name: Lake Logan
candidates.note: Hosts Camp Henry, an Episcopal summer camp with age-group residential sessions.

candidates.name: Daniel Boone Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Daniel Boone offers Scouts BSA residential summer camp and high-adventure programs.

candidates.name: Piedmont Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Bud Schiele offers Scouts BSA summer camp and Cub Scout resident camp.

candidates.name: YMCA Camp Greenville
candidates.note: Traditional overnight camp, adventure and leadership programs for rising grades K–12.

candidates.name: Asbury Hills Camp and Retreat Center
candidates.note: Christian residential summer programs for ages 7–17; 2027 registration announced.
